info.title: ZippyGo Platform API
info.description: HTTP API of the ZippyGo platform: ordering, dispatch, fleet and commerce for on-demand delivery.

get.summary:
The public keys access tokens are signed with (RFC 7517), for local verification by the
apps and future services.
Liveness probe: the process is up and serving requests. Does not touch dependencies.

The catalogue entry for a problem code: its title, status, whether retrying can help, a
description and the field-level codes it may carry. Every problem's `type` resolves here.

Readiness probe: every store is reachable. Returns 503 with the same body otherwise, so load
balancers stop routing traffic here until the dependency recovers.

post.summary:
A grant for a platform purpose (a Vertical image, a category image, campaign artwork);
platform staff. The answer names where to post the file and the form to post it with.

403.description: Not platform staff, or a Partner purpose on the platform route

409.description: No capability grants the purpose yet

503.description: The destination is not configured here

get.summary: The catalogue of purposes with the rules of each.

One asset: its state, the facts the destination reported and, for a stored public asset,
its address. Platform assets are visible to every signed-in person; a Partner's to its
members and platform staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

delete.summary:
Discards an asset and everything derived from it, deleting the bytes at the destination;
the row stays readable as discarded. Owners and managers, or platform staff.

403.description: Not allowed to write the asset's owner

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

Confirms an upload: the platform asks the destination to describe the file and takes every
fact from that answer. Owners and managers of the Partner, or platform staff.

403.description: Not allowed to write the asset's owner

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: The destination has not received the file (retry the same grant), the file arrived readable by anyone (ask for a new grant), or the asset is discarded (`asset_not_usable`)

Cuts a crop from a stored picture: a new asset deriving from the original, with the
rectangle in the original's pixels and the editor's recipe. Owners and managers, or
platform staff.

parameters.description: The picture, or a crop of it (the crop is cut from the original again)

A signed link to a restricted file, good for ten minutes; the reading is recorded. Members

A sized rendition of a public picture, `thumb` (160 wide), `card` (480) or `hero` (1200),
cut from the lossless crop, as WebP where the client accepts it; answered with a redirect
to the cached file. Public.

The audit log, newest first, in pages. Platform staff read every entry; a partner member

parameters.description: Only acts on this record id

parameters.name: partner_id

parameters.name: from

parameters.name: to

One entry.

parameters.description: The partner the entry belongs to; required for partner members

403.description: A partner member without a partner named

post.summary:
Requests a one-time code by email or SMS. Always accepted for a well-formed identifier, so
nothing reveals whether an account exists; the user is created on the first verification.
Limited per identifier and per client address.

202.description: A code is on its way

409.description: `sign_in_closed`: the number's country is not accepting sign-in

503.description: A store or the delivery provider is unavailable

post.summary:
Exchanges a one-time code for tokens. Five wrong codes lock the challenge
(`too_many_attempts`); an unknown, used or expired challenge is `code_expired`.

200.description: Signed in; browsers also receive the `zg_refresh` cookie

post.summary:
Sets the password of the signed-in user. The current password is required once one is set
(`forbidden` when missing or wrong). Other sessions of the user are revoked.

403.description: The user has a password and `current_password` is missing or wrong

post.summary:
Email and password sign-in. Unknown accounts and wrong passwords are both `unauthenticated`,
in the same time.

200.description: Signed in; browsers also receive the `zg_refresh` cookie

post.summary:
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. Browsers send the cookie; native
clients send `refresh_token` in the body. Presenting a token that was already rotated
revokes the whole session. When a cookie-borne token is refused, the cookie is cleared.

requestBody.description: Optional; omit it when the cookie carries the token

200.description: New tokens; browsers also receive a new `zg_refresh` cookie

401.description: No token, an unknown or rotated token, or a revoked or expired session

post.summary: Ends the session of the token and clears the cookie.

204.description: Signed out; the `zg_refresh` cookie is cleared

get.summary:
The newest domain events, newest first. Poll with `after` set to the newest id already seen.
Platform staff see every event; partner members see their partners' events.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events newer than this event id (exclusive); poll with the newest id seen

get.summary:
Agents with their status and last known position, filterable by partner and status. Platform
staff see every partner; partner members see the partners they belong to.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Only this partner's agents; every readable partner when omitted

404.description: The partner in the query is not one the caller belongs to, answered like an unknown id

post.summary:
Accepts a batch of position reports. Requires the step 0 development credential in
`X-Dev-Api-Key`. Validation problems are 400, unknown agents 422.

400.description: The batch failed validation; `errors` points at each field

422.description: A ping references an agent that does not exist; `errors` points at the pings

get.summary:
Health of the API with the running version and the server time. Unauthenticated; for plain
uptime monitoring. `degraded` when any dependency is impaired or down.

Health of the API and of each dependency: Postgres, Valkey and the event outbox. The overall
status is the worst check; the HTTP status is 200 for `ok` and `degraded`, 503 for `down`,
with the same body.

200.description: The service is ok or degraded

503.description: The service is down; the body names the failing checks

post.summary:
Accepts an invitation by its token: creates the user if needed, creates the membership and
signs the person in (cookie or body as for the sign-in operations).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the invitation email

requestBody.description: Optional; used only when the user is created

200.description: Accepted: the session and the membership

400.description: Malformed body, or a weak password (`password_weak` on `/password`)

get.summary:
Live stream of agent positions and statuses: a `snapshot` frame of every matching agent when
the stream opens, then `position` and `status` frames as they change, plus a `heartbeat`
every 15 seconds. Missed frames are not replayed; reconnect for a fresh snapshot. The access
token goes in the `Authorization` header or, for `EventSource`, in `?access_token=`.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Only this partner's agents; every readable partner when omitted

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The access token, for clients that cannot set the Authorization header (EventSource)

404.description: The partner in the query is not one the caller belongs to, answered like an unknown id

get.summary: Whether live updates are available and how a client should behave; public.

Live stream of domain events as they are published: `event` events carrying an `Event` as
JSON, plus a `heartbeat` every 15 seconds. Platform staff see every event; partner members
see their partners' events. The access token goes in the `Authorization` header or, for
`EventSource`, in `?access_token=`.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The access token, for clients that cannot set the Authorization header (EventSource)

200.description: Server-sent events: `event` frames carrying an Event as JSON, and `heartbeat` every 15 seconds

get.summary:
Opens the stream: every channel named is parsed and, when private, authorised against the
caller's facts before any frame flows. Frames: `snapshot` or `resync` per channel when the
stream opens, then `signal`, `agent.position` and `agent.status` as things change,
`heartbeat` every 15 seconds, and `close` when the platform ends the stream
(`token_expired`, `revoked`, `replaced`). The access token goes in the `Authorization`
header or, for `EventSource`, in `?access_token=`; public channels need none.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.description: Comma-separated channel names from the closed vocabulary

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The client's id for this connection; a new connection with the same id replaces the old one

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The access token, for clients that cannot set the Authorization header (EventSource)

200.description: Server-sent events: `snapshot` or `resync` per channel, then `signal`, `agent.position`, `agent.status`, `heartbeat` and finally `close`

400.description: No channels, too many, or a name no channel produces (`channel_unknown`, errors by position)

401.description: A private channel without a credential, or an invalid token

403.description: A channel this population may not hear, errors by position

404.description: A Location or Partner channel the caller does not belong to, answered like an unknown id

503.description: Live updates are not configured in this environment

get.summary: The signed-in user with every membership and their platform roles.

Documents on file across Partners, oldest first: Mission Control's review queue. Filter with
`review`, `kind` and `partner_id` or the full grammar; platform realm only (`partner:read`).

parameters.name: review
parameters.description: Only documents in this review state

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter tree as JSON over `review`, `kind`, `partner_id` and `uploaded_at`

get.summary:
Partners in pages, newest first by default; platform realm only. Filter with the named
parameters or the full grammar in `filter`, sort with up to three declared keys and ask for
facet counts alongside the page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only partners whose name or legal name contains this text

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter tree as JSON; see GET /v1/partners/filters

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort keys, comma separated, `-` for descending (default `-created_at`)

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Enumeration fields to count, comma separated (`status`, `kind`)

400.description: A parameter was refused; `errors` names each with its code

post.summary:
Creates a partner, `pending`, as one operation. From the Partner console the caller becomes
its owner. Mission Control onboards a Partner on its behalf by naming its administrator in
`owner`, who is invited by email as owner; platform staff must name one, and a failure
anywhere, the email included, leaves no Partner behind. Platform staff activate it with
`PATCH /v1/partners/{partner_id}` once nothing blocks it. Send `Idempotency-Key` to make a
repeated creation answer the first.
post.description:
Permissions once access lands: any signed-in person from the Partner console; Mission
Control's onboarding needs `partner:write` and `staff:write`.

201.description: The partner, `pending`, with its owner or its administrator invited

400.description: Malformed body, invalid fields (`gstin_invalid`, `pan_invalid`), or platform staff without an `owner`

403.description: An `owner` named by somebody who is not platform staff

503.description: A store or mail delivery is unavailable; nothing was created

get.summary:
The fields partners can be filtered, sorted and faceted by, so a console builds its filter
bar from the declaration.

Counts of every partner by status and kind, without fetching rows, from a copy at most 30
seconds old; platform realm only.
One partner, for its members and platform staff.

200.description: The partner, with its version as the `ETag`

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

patch.summary:
Changes the members present in the body. Owners and managers change the profile; only
platform staff change `status`, with a `reason` kept in the audit log. Send `If-Match` with
the version you hold to be refused when someone else changed the partner first.

200.description: The partner after the change, with its new `ETag`

403.description: The role does not allow the change

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `activation_blocked` with the blockers, `illegal_transition`, `locations_open` on archiving, or `partner_archived`

412.description: `If-Match` no longer matches: someone changed the partner first

get.summary:
What activating the partner needs: its status and every blocker (nobody administering it,
the documents it must have approved), the checklist the consoles show before an attempt and
the same blockers an attempt is refused with. Members and platform staff.
get.description:
Permissions once access lands: `partner:access` for members, `partner:read` for platform
staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

A grant for a Partner's purpose (document, logo, banner) or one of its Locations' (logo,
banner); owners and managers of the Partner, or platform staff. A Location of another
Partner is not found.

403.description: Neither owner nor manager, or a platform purpose on the Partner route

404.description: Unknown partner or Location, or not the caller's

409.description: No capability grants the purpose yet

503.description: The destination is not configured here

Applies the Partner's banner as soon as it is stored, or removes it with `null`: a confirmed
`partner_banner` asset, twice as wide as tall. Owners and managers, or platform staff.

400.description: Malformed body, or a picture that is not twice as wide as tall

403.description: The role does not brand the Partner

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `asset_not_usable`: not a stored banner of this Partner

The documents on file, newest first, with every kind the Partner must have and where each
stands; members and platform staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary:
Files a compliance document, pending review: the file is uploaded first under the
`partner_document` purpose (private storage) and confirmed. Owners and managers, or platform
staff on the Partner's behalf.

400.description: Malformed body, or an expiry before the issue date

403.description: The role does not file documents

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `asset_not_usable`: not a stored document of this Partner; `partner_archived`

One document on file; members and platform staff. The file itself is read through

delete.summary: Takes a document off file; owners and managers, or platform staff.

403.description: The role does not remove documents

Reviews a document: approves it, or rejects it with a note the Partner reads and its
contacts are told; an approval is withdrawn by a rejection. Platform staff only, a separate
authority from writing the Partner.

400.description: Malformed body, or a rejection without a note

409.description: `illegal_transition`: a rejected document is replaced, not reviewed again

503.description: A store or mail delivery is unavailable

get.summary: The partner's invitations, newest first; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary: Invites an email address; owners and managers, and only owners may grant `owner`.

201.description: The invitation; the email is on its way

403.description: Neither owner nor manager, or a manager granting owner

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: Already a member, or already invited

503.description: A store or mail delivery is unavailable

delete.summary: Revokes a pending invitation; owners and managers.

get.summary: The partner's locations, oldest first.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary: Adds a location; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

422.description: The pin is outside every service area

get.summary: The Locations in the bin, oldest first; members and platform staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: One location of the partner.

200.description: The location, with its version as the `ETag`

delete.summary:
Deletes a Location softly: it leaves every listing and read at once and keeps its record,
pictures, hours and settings for a restore from the bin. Owners and managers.

403.description: The role does not delete Locations

patch.summary:
Changes the members present in the body; owners and managers. Send `If-Match` with the
version you hold to be refused when someone else changed the location first.

200.description: The location after the change, with its new `ETag`

412.description: `If-Match` no longer matches: someone changed the location first

422.description: The moved pin is outside every service area

get.summary:
What going live needs for the Location: its status and every blocker (its Partner not
active; for a store, no fulfilment, closed all week, no Vertical), the checklist the consoles
show before an attempt. Members and platform staff.

put.summary:
Applies the Location's banner as soon as it is stored, or removes it with `null`: a
confirmed `location_banner` asset, twice as wide as tall. Owners and managers.

400.description: Malformed body, or a picture that is not twice as wide as tall

403.description: The role does not brand Locations

put.summary:
Replaces how orders leave the store: a method's presence enables it, own agents need the
Partner's delivery Service, dine-in needs tables (not yet), and switching delivery off
discards its zone. A branch has no fulfilment. Owners and managers.

403.description: The role does not change Locations, or `not_in_plan` for the platform fleet

409.description: `service_required`: own agents without a delivery Service, a branch, dine-in

get.summary:
The upcoming public holidays of the Location's country, each saying whether the Location
is already closed that day and by which layer. Members and platform staff.

post.summary:
Marks a public holiday closed at the Location in one act: a closed-all-day closure named
after the holiday, added to the Location's own schedule. A holiday already covered says so.
Owners and managers.

200.description: The Location's schedule layer as saved

400.description: Not an upcoming public holiday of the Location's country

403.description: The role does not change Locations

put.summary:
Replaces how the store appears: reviews on or off, search tags (lower cased and
de-duplicated), and the highlights, which only platform staff set. Owners and managers.

403.description: The role does not change Locations, or highlights set by a member

Applies the Location's tile as soon as it is stored, or removes it with `null`: a confirmed
`location_logo` asset, square. Owners and managers.

400.description: Malformed body, or a picture that is not square

403.description: The role does not brand Locations

put.summary:
Changes how the store takes orders; absent members are kept. The slot length, the cap per
slot, the auto-reject window and prescriptions are platform staff's; slot settings sent
while scheduled orders are off are refused; the window is at most seven days. Owners and
managers.

200.description: The Location with its order settings

403.description: The role does not change Locations, or a platform staff's setting

post.summary:
Pauses the Location for one minute to a day with a reason, recording who; it takes orders
again at that moment by itself. Pausing is operational: an active store paused for the
evening is still active. Owners and managers.

200.description: The Location, offline until the pause ends

400.description: More than a day, or a custom reason without its message

403.description: The role does not pause Locations

delete.summary: Resumes a paused Location now. Owners and managers.

200.description: The Location, taking orders again when open

403.description: The role does not resume Locations

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the location's service policy layer; owners and managers.

get.summary:
The effective policy of the location: the country, the service areas, the partner and the
location folded, every field with the layer and version that supplied it.

200.description: The effective policy with its provenance

get.summary: Every version of the location's policy layer, newest first.

post.summary: Restores a Location from the bin exactly as it was. Owners and managers.

403.description: The role does not restore Locations

404.description: Unknown partner, or no such Location in the bin

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the location's schedule layer; owners and managers.

get.summary:
The effective schedule of the location: the nearest week and every exception, in the
location's time zone.
Whether the location trades at an instant and when that changes.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: The instant asked about (RFC 3339); now when omitted

200.description: Open or closed, and until when

Applies the Partner's logo as soon as it is stored, or removes it with `null`: a confirmed
`partner_logo` asset, square. Owners and managers, or platform staff.

400.description: Malformed body, or a picture that is not square

403.description: The role does not brand the Partner

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `asset_not_usable`: not a stored logo of this Partner (a document is never a logo)

get.summary: The partner's members, oldest first.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

delete.summary: Removes a member; owners only, and never the last owner.

409.description: The last owner cannot be removed

404.description: Unknown partner, or no account stated yet

States or changes the payout account: it is unverified again after every write, a change of
account holds the next payout for at least 48 hours and until platform staff verify it, and
the masked number sent back unchanged keeps the account. Owners and managers, or platform
staff.

200.description: The account as saved, masked and unverified

403.description: The role does not change the account

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary:
Marks the payout account verified; platform staff only (the approval permission). Payouts
resume once any hold after a change of account is over.

404.description: Unknown partner, or no account stated

The Partner's plan: what it includes, the Pro trial, a change waiting, and the plans on
offer. Members and platform staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

put.summary:
Changes the Partner's plan. Platform staff move it, with a reason, now or at
`effective_at`; at that moment every Service of a kind the new plan lacks is disabled, and
the Partner is told by email. The owner, or platform staff, choose the plan the trial ends

400.description: Malformed body, or a move without a reason

403.description: Not the owner, or a move by somebody who is not platform staff

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

503.description: A store or mail delivery is unavailable

What moving the Partner to a plan would stop: the kinds it lacks, the Services of those
kinds with their Locations, and whether its stores keep the platform fleet; shown before a

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

put.summary: Saves a new version of the partner's service policy layer; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

Saves a new version of the partner's schedule layer (the default week of its locations);
owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary:
The registry of the Partner: its Services with where each is switched on, whether it
trades and what stops it; every kind as enabled, awaiting documents, disabled, available or
not in the plan; and the plan. Members and platform staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary:
Registers a Service: several of one kind are allowed. Enabled unless `enabled` is `false`;
a kind the plan lacks is refused naming the plan that has it; a kind needing documents not
yet approved (product sales of a food catalogue type needs the FSSAI licence) lands in
`awaiting_documents`, configurable and not trading. Switched on everywhere unless
`location_ids` names some. Send `Idempotency-Key` to make a repeated creation answer the
first. Owners and managers; platform staff with a reason.

400.description: Malformed body, a configuration of the wrong shape, a Location not the Partner's, or platform staff without a reason

403.description: Neither owner nor manager, or `not_in_plan`: the plan does not include the kind

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary:
One Service: by its id, or by a kind for the Partner's first Service of that kind. Members
and platform staff; another Partner's Service is not found.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: A Service id, or a kind (`product_sales`, `field_service`, `delivery`) naming the Partner's first Service of that kind

400.description: Neither a Service id nor a kind

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

400.description: Unknown kind, malformed body, `awaiting_documents` sent, or platform staff without a reason

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

patch.summary:
Changes a Service, by id or by kind: its name, its configuration as a whole, where it is
switched on, and enabling or disabling it. Disabling stops its trade at once and keeps the
configuration; re-enabling restores it as it was, waiting for documents its kind needs.
Owners and managers; platform staff with a reason.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: A Service id, or a kind naming the Partner's first Service of that kind

400.description: Malformed body, a configuration of the wrong shape, `awaiting_documents` sent, a Location not the Partner's, or platform staff without a reason

403.description: Neither owner nor manager, or `not_in_plan` on enabling

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

A Service at one Location: whether it is switched on there and trades, and a field
Service's area, hours and slots there. Members and platform staff.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

`enabled` or `disabled`; enabling lands in `awaiting_documents` while the kind needs
documents not approved.

ServicesBlock.description: What a bookable service of a type collects, the `ServicesBlock` schema.

cancellation_notice.description: Whether a cancellation notice in hours is stated.

deposit.description: Whether a deposit may be taken.

duration.description: Whether a service states its duration.

Setting.description: A setting as served, the `Setting` schema.

reason.description: Why it is admitted.

updated_at.description: When the stored value was set.

value.description: The value in force: the override when one is stored and in range, else the default.

items.description: Every setting with the value in force.

value.description: The value, within the declared bounds.

Signal.description:
A signal, the data of a `signal` frame and the `Signal` schema. Clients refetch on a signal
rather than apply it; one holding a version equal to or newer than `version` may skip.

channel.description: The channel the signal belongs to.

status.description: Its new status, where it has one.

version.description: Its version, which only rises per aggregate.

SignedLink.description: A signed link to a restricted file, the `SignedLink` schema.

url.description: The link; works until `expires_at` and never again.

SlotHours.description: Hours of the week a campaign slot shows, in the service area's own clock.

to.description: Until this local time; `00:00` means midnight at the close of the day.

SlotLink.description: What a campaign slot links to, the `SlotLink` schema.

targets.description:
The target ids: exactly one for a Vertical, Partner or campaign; one or more Location
ids for `locations`; one or more `location_id/product_id` for `products`.

SlotShape.description: The shape of a campaign slot: artwork is drawn for one width, so it never changes.

SnapshotFrame.description:
Data of a `snapshot` frame: the current facts of a channel whose frames carry facts, the
`AgentsSnapshot` schema.

agents.description: Every agent the channel covers, at the time the stream opened.

SourcedAmount.description: An amount in minor units with the layer that supplied it, the `SourcedAmount` schema.

source.description: Whose decision it was: the layer and the version that supplied the value.

SourcedException.description: An exception with the layer that declared it.

SourcedFlag.description: A yes or no with the layer that supplied it, the `SourcedFlag` schema.

source.description: Whose decision it was: the layer and the version that supplied the value.

SourcedLadder.description: A fee ladder with the layer that supplied it, the `SourcedLadder` schema.

source.description: Whose decision it was: the layer and the version that supplied the value.

SourcedRate.description: A percentage with the layer that supplied it, the `SourcedRate` schema.

source.description: Whose decision it was: the layer and the version that supplied the value.

Standing.description: The Partner console's view of its registration and standing, the `PartnerStanding` schema.

activation.description: What activation needs, with every blocker.

oneOf.description: The payout account, masked; `null` until stated.

payouts_may_go.description: Whether the next payout may go out now: the account verified and any hold over.

requirements.description:
Every document the Partner must have on file and where each stands: its review, its
expiry, and what it does to trading.

status_reason.description: Why it is in that status, shown while it is suspended.

withheld_permissions.description: The permissions withheld from the Partner's entitlement envelope.

StandingSummary.description: What the directory row carries beside a Partner, the `PartnerStandingSummary` schema.

can_trade.description: Whether the Partner can trade now: active, and no document has stopped every Location.

documents_missing.description: Required documents missing, rejected or expired.

nobody_can_sign_in.description: `true` when nobody can sign in to the Partner, which platform staff should notice.

runs.description: The kinds of Service it runs: those with a Service enabled or awaiting documents.

StatusChangeBody.description:
A status change with its reason, the `StatusChange` schema. The reason is required where
the capability demands one (countries, service areas).

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit log.

fields.description: The typed extra fields its Locations carry.

status.description: Lifecycle; only `active` may be given to a new Location.

fields.description: Typed extra fields, from the store field catalogue.

StrandedLocation.description: A Location a division would strand, named in the refusal.

SwitchBody.description: Request body of the switch routes, the `SwitchChange` schema.

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit log; required.

Target.description: The record an entry is about: a reference, never a copy.

id.description: The record's id (a UUID or a natural key such as a country code).

kind.description: The kind of record, for example `partner`, `country` or `service_area`.

label.description: The record's display label at the time, when known.

access_token.description: The access token, a JWT for the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token for native clients; `null` for browsers, which get the cookie.

Trading.description: Whether a Location trades at an instant, the `Trading` schema.

until.description: When that changes, in the Location's zone.

TradingEffect.description: What a requirement does to trading.

TypeField.description: A typed extra field a type declares, the `TypeField` schema.

key.description: The key, from the closed field catalogue.

required.description: Whether a record of the type must carry it.

UploadGrant.description: A grant to post one file straight to the destination, the `UploadGrant` schema.

content_type.description: The exact content type the destination accepts for this grant.

fields.description: The form fields to send, every one of them, before the file part.

file_field.description: The name of the file part, sent last.

key.description: The object key the destination will hold the file under; confirm with it.

max_bytes.description: The largest size the destination accepts for this grant, in bytes.

User.description: A person, the `User` schema: who they are, never what they may do (that is a membership).

display_name.description: The name the user is shown under, `null` until set.

email.description: Email address, normalised; `null` for phone-only users.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164; `null` for email-only users.

VehicleKind.description: A vehicle a delivery Service runs.

VehicleType.description: A vehicle type with what it carries, the `VehicleType` schema.

image_asset_id.description: The image shown on its tile.

VerticalCategory.description: A category of a Vertical, the `VerticalCategory` schema.

id.description: Identity that outlives renames and reorders.

VerticalCategoryInput.description: One category as sent, the `VerticalCategoryInput` schema; the id is kept when given.

id.description: The identity to keep; a fresh one when omitted.

VerticalIdsBody.description: Request body of the Vertical set and order routes, the `VerticalIds` schema.

asset_id.description: The image asset, or `null` to clear.

VerticalKind.description: Whether a Vertical lists product sales or field services.

VerticalOffer.description: A Vertical as a service area offers it, the `VerticalOffer` schema.

inherited_from.description: The ancestor whose declaration reaches here, when inherited.

offered.description: Whether the Vertical trades here: declared here or inherited, and the Vertical active.

offered_here.description: Whether this service area declares the offer itself.

items.description: The Verticals as the area offers them, in its order.

Window.description: An open window of a day, the `Window` schema.

to.description: Closes at; `00:00` means midnight at the close of the day.

Workflow.description: The workflow of a field service.

Bearer.description: An access token issued by the sign-in operations: a JWT signed with EdDSA (Ed25519), valid for 15 minutes, verifiable with the keys at /.well-known/jwks.json.
